title: Q-METRIC-OPEN-ITEMS: open_items 127 vs <= 100; lever probe-closable
body:
**Owner:** operations
**Trigger:** metric loop pass: open_items outside its healthy condition
**Done check:** cmd:python3 -m foundation metricloop --probe open_items
**Status:** closed

Metric `open_items` (target) reads 127; healthy is <= 100. Open queue items (docs/issues OL-* and Q-*); the queue must drain faster than it fills.
Lever now: **probe-closable**: Run `python3 -m foundation contracts --tick --apply` from the executor so every item whose closing probe passes closes in the same pass.
The loop judges this lever after the efficacy window; a lever that did not move the metric is replaced here, not repeated.

size: S

**Disposition:** shelved (ttl, 2026-11-21T18:12:26Z, DISPOSE-1)

**Evidence:** open 157.1 hours (limit 6 hours) and no loop closed it (SLA-8H-1). Its closing probe still runs on every fleet pass and records `fixed` when it passes; the executor retries it when its open queue is empty (every 30 days at most).
